limits: This is an internal normalized graph, not the public project-model artifact. It retains confidence, byte column, and source digest; the frozen openbox.project-model/v1 provenance projection permits only detector, basis, path, and line.

Internal signals are descriptor and coverage inputs only. They must not be serialized as invented project-model nodes, and their absence from the public model must not be described as public graph coverage.
A project with no supported node evidence is not representable under the accepted v1 nodes minItems=1 contract and fails honestly; this implementation does not synthesize a project/root node.

Call-name classification and site anchoring remain inferred static hypotheses. Stable means deterministic for the same selected bytes; source relocation can intentionally change a site-scoped identity.

No edges are present because co-location is not relationship evidence. Reachability, data class, actor, interception, and observed edges remain unknown until an authorized detector or controlled run supplies them.

No public model serialization/schema validation, SDK descriptor, expected coverage, CLI inspection output, runtime import/execution, package installation, model/network call, sandbox, receiver/Core path, production coordinate, external control plane, paid path, or live security evaluation ran.
